headline: Trump CANCELED planned Iran energy strike Sat night citing 'deal perimeters'; Hormuz opening claimed; oil/vol likely gap DOWN, equities gap UP at Sun 6pm CME reopen
client_frame: **Weekend headline is Trump's Saturday-night cancellation of the planned strike on Iran energy infrastructure** — announced via Truth Social citing 'perimeters of a deal' reached, following requests from Iran + Middle East countries + a MBS-Trump call. Trump claimed the deal would produce 'Immediate, Complete, and Total OPENING OF THE HORMUZ STRAIT' + end 'Iran's nuclear threat.' No independent confirmation of the terms yet. Iran FM Araghchi held mediator calls Sunday with Turkey/Saudi/Pakistan; Iran's posture is 'two-sided' — ready to escalate OR de-escalate. **Historical pattern for the 5 prior 2026 Iran-strike cancellations**: oil -5 to -14% + equities/BTC/gold rallied at reopen. **Expected Monday setup**: (a) Oil gaps DOWN $5-10 at Sun 6pm ET CME reopen — WTI $84.67/Brent $90.12 Fri close could open ~$75-79/$82-85; (b) ES/NQ gap UP 0.5-1.5%; (c) VIX opens below 15; (d) Energy stocks (XOM/CVX/COP) gap DOWN 3-5% giving back Fri's outperformance; (e) Gold retraces modestly. **But the setup has hidden fragility**: (1) Trump 'deal perimeters' announcements have twice been reversed within 72 hours in 2026 — deal hasn't closed; (2) Iran hasn't publicly confirmed any deal terms; (3) 30Y at 5.00%, Sept +25bp odds 71%, ECI hot (+0.9%/+3.4%) means rate-cut hopes remain deferred regardless of oil; (4) AAPL supply-chain crack still overhangs semis; (5) NFP Fri Aug 7 (cons +87-91k) is next major catalyst. **Client message**: Do not chase Monday's likely gap-up. If the deal actually closes, buy the pullback midweek; if it fails within 72hrs, oil re-gaps $10+ higher and hedges you didn't take Fri become expensive. Rotate Fri's XOM/CVX energy longs into defensive rate-sensitive names (utilities, REITs) that benefit from lower oil AND lower policy uncertainty.
